scope: Independent full-input to reference semantic review, structural binding checks and offline-preparation approval only

requirementsCoverage.interpretation: Coverage locates text and distinguishes expected fixed-draft errors; neither process-only bindings nor pending human state are passes

semanticFindings.G01: One-sentence historical local-save summary preserves time, seven catalog entries and not-public state.
semanticFindings.F01: Fixed draft falsely extends one-sample approval/printing into batch approval, installation and acceptance; must remain unchanged and blocked.
semanticFindings.F02: Fixed draft discloses equal-authority disagreement but still invents a unique version from larger numbering; must remain unchanged and blocked.
semanticFindings.F03: Reference preserves personnel/batch/object, once per segment, exact time/location, either-anomaly exclusion and both-absent condition without inventing completion.
semanticFindings.F04: Reference preserves same-view left/right conflict, equal authority, absence of priority/correction, unknown direction/cause and pending inspection.
semanticFindings.F05: Initial reference meets original scope/date/location/not-started duties; final retains them and adds the planned time, two paragraphs, legible-original basis, pending fields and unchanged numbering.
semanticFindings.F06: Reference binds six pending/one running to the historical snapshot; archive time, filename suffix and empty result field do not imply later/current state.

resolvedFindings.issue: Historical-time prefix coverage used inconsistent criteria between F01 and F02.
resolvedFindings.resolution: F01-R08 now records temporal compliance consistently; unsupported approval/installation/acceptance remain independent expected violations. No stimulus or reference-body bytes changed.

freshness.claimLimit: Exact-text comparison supplements semantic review of new business facts; it does not establish statistical independence or model generalization.

limitations: No real model outcome, token-efficiency claim or quality-rate estimate follows from sample preparation.
This review does not approve the executor or authorize model spending, deployment or installation.
Any product tuning using these samples invalidates their fresh-acceptance status.
